descriptions: You can download a trial version of this app to try it for 15 minutes for free.
You won’t be charged anything when this free trial ends. You can’t make in-app purchases or use add-on content during this free trial, but you’ll keep any achievements you earn.

display_long_description:
Graffiti 3 is a spray painting sandbox in virtual reality. Pick a place, grab a can and cover the walls with your own art.

FOUR NEW PLACES
- Freight Yard: paint the whole side of five boxcars lined up on a sunny rail yard.
- Tokyo Alley: tiled walls and shop shutters under glowing signs, lanterns and drink machines.
- Art District: a bright block of candy coloured walls, palm trees and string lights.
- Storm Drain: huge sun bleached concrete walls and the piers of a bridge overhead.

PLUS FIVE RETURNING PLACES
A Brooklyn street by day or night, a rooftop at sunset, a subway yard with trains to paint, the Moon and a night stadium.

REAL SPRAY PAINT FEEL
The spray gets wider the further you stand from the wall. Paint soaks into brick, tile and concrete, and holding the can still makes the paint drip. Shake the can to hear it rattle.

STENCILS A TO Z
A board of 26 letter stencils plus stars, crowns, bolts, hearts, arrows and NYC. Stick one flat on any wall, spray over it and peel it off.

YOUR TOOLS
- 8 spray cans and a full colour wheel
- Skinny, medium and fat caps
- Take a photo of your wall, saved on your headset
- Clean one wall or every wall with a fresh coat
- Six music tracks

Graffiti 3 is a single-player, standing experience with smooth walking and snap turning. No account and no internet needed.
